status_note: Registered on 2026-11-27 before any GPTQ perplexity of this comparison was measured. THME-2205, ROADMAP v0.2.2.5.

evaluation.scoring_note: Full test split in consecutive windows of 1024 (thme evaluate defaults), same protocol as the verification reports.

calibration.source: the seed-1234 calibration token file of awq_calibration.json

comparators.note: Their perplexities are read from that file, not re-run.

arms.description: GPTQ-style Q4_0 rounding (thme.gptq_q4_0) on every weight matrix, calibration statistics from the seed-1234 file; deterministic, one run.

preregistration.registered_before: any measured GPTQ perplexity for this comparison
preregistration.noise_scale: sigma = sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the five AWQ-seed perplexities recorded in awq_calibration.json for this model and Q4_0.
decision_rule: GPTQ beats round-to-nearest only if RTN perplexity minus GPTQ perplexity is greater than 2 x sigma.

GPTQ beats AWQ only if the mean AWQ perplexity over its five seeds minus GPTQ perplexity is greater than 2 x sigma; GPTQ is worse than AWQ only if GPTQ perplexity minus that mean is greater than 2 x sigma; otherwise the report says no difference was shown.
Gate: reported for the repository default (v1: at most 0.45 above the ceiling) and for gate v2 (configs/gates/thme-perplexity-v2.json).

A null or negative result is a valid result and is reported as one. Calibration seed, format, damping default, thresholds and this rule are fixed here and are not changed after any measured result is seen.
limits: One calibration seed, so GPTQ's own seed variance is not measured; sigma comes from the AWQ arm.
Q4_0 only: K-quants are not supported by thme.gptq_*.
One corpus (WikiText-2 test), one model per file.

gptq.backend: THME reference CPU forward pass (f32, multithreaded)

gptq_gate_v2.backend: THME reference CPU forward pass (f32, multithreaded)
